message.content: Hunting for a controller or tank-limit break — starting with an extreme proportional-gain probe.

Ledger still open: net-inflow overload vs missing spill-clamp; ruling out noise vs bias. Checking earlier buildup steps.
Ledger open: unavoidable-overflow vs missing spill-clamp · ruled out: none yet; inspecting origin to trace net inflow.

Ledger open: unavoidable-overflow with valve saturated and spill missing · ruled out: controllable-inflow (lowering inflow to 2 passes). Submitting grounded overflow report.
